### Blaze — G4 Wonderbolt

**Who she is.** Blaze is the **yellow Pegasus Wonderbolt with a vivid orange, swept-up mane, purple eyes, and orange-flame cutie mark**. She resembles Spitfire but is a **different mare**. Usually she wears the Wonderbolts' blue-and-yellow flight suit, which covers her cutie mark. [Character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Blaze).

**Appearances.** She debuts in Rainbow Dash's Wonderbolts fantasy in **“The Ticket Master”**, then appears in **“Sonic Rainboom,” “The Best Night Ever,” “Sweet and Elite,”** and **“Secret of My Excess”** (helping fight giant Spike). Her most identifiable role is **“Rarity Investigates!”**: she initially questions Rainbow Dash's innocence, searches for missing Spitfire with Misty Fly, and reports back. She also appears in **“Newbie Dash”** and later Wonderbolt group scenes.

**Name and voice.** **Blaze is an established official G4 name**, not just a fan placeholder. *The Elements of Harmony* guidebook (2013) listed “Blaze” among the Wonderbolts **without identifying which mare**; in “Rarity Investigates!” (2015), Soarin explicitly addresses **“Misty Fly, Blaze”**, establishing the on-screen identification. She **speaks** in that episode, voiced in English by **Tabitha St. Germain**. [Naming history](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Forum%3ACharacter_names_in_second-_and_third-party_sources); [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Rarity_Investigates%21); [episode cast](https://pro.imdb.com/title/tt4534326/).

**Separate game storyline.** In Gameloft's *My Little Pony* mobile game, Blaze eventually becomes **Feather Bangs's special somepony** during the 2018 Hearts and Hooves event. That is a **game-continuity story**, not an event shown in the television series. [Game character entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Blaze).
